newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Sunny skies seen in key Brazil soybean area - Somar.
newsitem.headline: Sunny skies seen in key Brazil soybean area - Somar.

text.p: The weather will remain dry in Brazil's southern soybean growing regions after the passage of a cold front through Rio Grande do Sul state at the weekend and in Parana on Monday, independent meteorologist Somar said.
"No rains are forecast in the southern region for the rest of the week. Only in the soybean areas of the centre-west do rains occur, although in very isolated form," Somar said in a weekly report.
The south was forecast to remain sunny although a south wind will cause a decline in temperatures. In Mato Grosso, isolated showers were set to continue.

Somar said the main soybean producing regions in the centre and south had been dry until the arrival of the cold front in Rio Grande do Sul at the weekend which brought increased cloud cover and rains of up to 20 mm in the west of the state.
The cold front was weaker by the time it reached Parana on Monday, it said.
